poetryFrame.leftVertical: A WHISPER OF WHAT I ONCE WAS, LOST IN THE SHADOWS OF TIME.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: THE ECHOES OF A LIGHT THAT DAZZLED BEFORE THE WEIGHT OF ADULTHOOD.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: I YEARN FOR THE SOFTNESS OF YESTERDAY'S SELF.

lyrics.text: There's still a small part of me
That's buried underneath
The growing bags under my eyes
And the light of the early sunrise
I think about it often
The last bit of my softness
That hides beneath the hard surface
I haven't yet fully lost it
When I look in the mirror
I can barely see her
I don't regret all the choices I've made
And if I did, what's the use anyway
I try not to dwell on what used to be
But sometimes, I miss the old me
Nobody knows what the future may bring
So I'll hold onto sentimental things
They say that the best is still yet to be
But sometimes, I just miss the old me
I try to live in the moment
But there's some reassurance
Of looking behind your shoulder
The more and more you get older
Maybe one day I'll be wiser
Let go of what's familiar
I'll think about it from time to time
Of how I lived a full life
When I look in the mirror
I'm beginning to see her
I don't regret all the choices I've made
And if I did, what's the use anyway
I try not to dwell on what used to be
But sometimes, I miss the old me
Nobody knows what the future may bring
So I'll hold onto sentimental things
They say the best is still yet to be
But sometimes, I miss the old me
Sometimes, I just miss the old me
